title: Approval delegations accept an inverted window (valid_until before valid_from) and a self-delegation, both 201 and silently inert
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33058 · approvals.ooo-delegation-reroute · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (stock showcase @ ee9ad834, admin as delegator)
1. `POST /api/v1/data/sys_approval_delegation` with `valid_from` later than `valid_until` → 201. A request routed to the delegator in that period is not rerouted (nothing can match the window).
2. `POST /api/v1/data/sys_approval_delegation` with `delegate` = the delegator → 201. Resolution leaves the request on the delegator; no `ooo_substitute` row.

Expected: both writes are refused with a validation error naming the field, so an author learns the delegation will never apply.

Low severity: no routing goes wrong; the author just gets no signal.
